label: R20-FINAL-PACK-CUT
title: Register final round-pack output before slot_result_r
write_regions: rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv::private iter_state_t and pack-result register declarations
rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv::reset/kill for new private pack result state
forbidden_regions: shared test registry and milestone documents
scope: Insert a private registered boundary for ordinary and iterative final round-pack result/flags/done before scalar output reaches slot_result_r, with a single coherent latency change and exact pause/kill/reset behavior.
validation: Lane runs only diff-check and lightweight static/elaboration checks; merged candidate owns heavy simulation. Focused test must cover H/S/D normal/subnormal/overflow/rounding/flags, DIV/SQRT finish, pause, kill, valid drop and exactly-once done/result.
acceptance: pack_mid no longer directly drives slot_result_r through the full round/output mux in one cycle; result and flags remain stable and commit exactly once; all affected latency changes are explicit for batch integration.
resource: No local or GamePC heavy job in the lane; no production lock required until merged validation.
